1.visual_beat: Varen hovers beneath the failing EAST support beam, BOTH white mitten hands braced overhead, holding the single sagging concrete span above blue water; no commander inserted as a ghost.
1.narration:
Your commander orders you to let go of the bridge while people are still crossing it.

You're holding the broken span above the water.

2.visual_beat: Mira stands beside the same cracked near expansion joint, waving ONE plain grey freight vehicle west toward the intact approach; traffic behind her waits.
2.narration: On the road above you, Mira is waving the last vehicle forward.

3.visual_beat: Rusk stands on the east road approach beside the same failed joint, one commanding hand extended toward the span, road and guardrail in their established positions.
3.narration: Commander Rusk is waiting for you to obey. You came to this planet to bring it into the Viltrum Empire.

4.visual_beat: Two anonymous adult white-round-headed residents in plain work coats walk west behind the same grey freight vehicle over the supported span. No copies of Varen.
4.narration: But the people crossing the road you're holding have spent months calling you their protector.

5.visual_beat: Rusk hovers threateningly on the free side of Varen, who keeps BOTH hands under the SAME east-support beam; show one instant of the refusal, no fighting double poses.
5.narration: Getting them across will mean fighting the man who sent you here.

6.visual_beat: Varen has just landed badly against the LEFT storage door; its lower panel is dented and one hinge displaced. Rusk approaches across the fixed square paving.
6.narration:
Your first landing during training ends with you crashing through a storage door.

Your name is Varen.

7.visual_beat: Rusk pushes the movable yellow-bordered LOW landing platform a short distance across the court. Varen watches; the three banners, central steps and left damaged door stay fixed.
7.narration: The training court has a high stone wall, a landing square, and an instructor who moves the square whenever you start getting comfortable.

8.visual_beat: Varen flies too low past the near edge of the yellow-bordered landing platform, hands spread for balance; he overshoots on the same court axis.
8.narration: You can already lift things that would crush an ordinary person. Staying in the air is harder. Your approach carries you straight past the landing square.

9.visual_beat: Varen gets up beside the dented LEFT storage door as Rusk approaches from the central steps. Same damaged door, no new wall opening.
9.narration: You get up from the broken doorway before Rusk reaches you, hoping the dent looks smaller from where he stands.

10.visual_beat: Varen lands with boots scraping across the yellow-bordered platform, leaving two short dark skid marks. Rusk observes from the fixed step side.
10.narration: He asks you to land again. The second time, you arrive low and fast. Your boots tear across the square.

11.visual_beat: Rusk points down at the TWO fresh boot-skid marks at Varen's red boots on the same low platform; crop on original axis, retain platform border.
11.narration: Rusk makes you look at the mark they leave. A strong body is useful to the Empire.

12.visual_beat: Varen bends toward the scraped platform while Talen waits beside it in grey with blue sash, indicating the damaged equipment rather than laughing at a new empty floor.
12.narration:
An uncontrolled one can destroy the equipment it was supposed to capture.

Talen trains beside you.

13.visual_beat: Talen in BLUE sash laughs softly and gestures at Varen's skid marks; Varen rubs the back of his pure-white round head. Same platform and three-banner wall behind.
13.narration: He wears a blue sash and laughs whenever you try to pretend a bad landing was intentional.

14.visual_beat: Talen has bumped his shoulder against the plain NORTH wall beside the central steps; Varen reaches to help. No fresh doorway or shifted banners.
14.narration: His own turn ends with him catching the wall with his shoulder.

15.visual_beat: Varen steadies Talen down from the wall. Talen points at the already dented LEFT storage door. One body per actor, both on the same court floor.
15.narration: You help him down, and he tells you that your storage door now looks quite reasonable.

16.visual_beat: Rusk stands on the existing THREE central steps with one hand directing the two trainees back toward the landing platform. Varen and Talen both obey from near landing platform.
16.narration: Rusk watches both of you from the steps. He gives you another drill before either of you can finish laughing.

Mira waves him toward the intact approach.

116.visual_beat: Varen holds BOTH hands under failing main girder and speaks firmly to Rusk hovering beside the near ledge; one commander only, no ghost.

You keep holding the beam.

124.visual_beat: Varen pivots and pulls Rusk upward over empty centre yard, ONE actor each; workshop/crane/gate remain in their fixed orientation.
124.narration: When he comes again, you turn aside and pull him above the empty part of the yard.

126.visual_beat: Varen lifts ONE fallen corrugated roof panel away from an anonymous adult worker crouched behind fixed back-wall rack; square roof hole above, front/side exits fixed. Rusk appears only at overhead roof opening, following Varen; worker remains safely below rack.

130.visual_beat: Varen intercepts Rusk at the near rock face beside broad shelf; one impact dislodges only small stone chips, no blood or demolished mountain.
130.narration: There, you stop turning away from his attacks. The next collision tears rock from the cliff.

131.visual_beat: Varen pins Rusk against SAME low rock face while distant single imperial transport lifts from tiny east harbour; no giant castle or extra ship.
131.narration: You hold him against the stone long enough to see the inspection transport lifting from the yard.

132.visual_beat: Talen at controls in ONE transport cockpit/ramp window lifts the landed imperial transport from SAME centre yard; Mira's grey work vehicles take LEFT bridge route.

133.narration: The transport rises beside the broken bridge instead of over the town. Rusk sees it and pulls free.

134.visual_beat: Varen grabs Rusk's black boot before he clears the ridge; both fall onto SAME lower stone shelf, one instant and one body each.
134.narration: He turns toward Talen. You catch his boot before he clears the headland, and both of you fall against the lower shelf.

135.visual_beat: Varen blocks Rusk BELOW the same low ridge while ONE grey transport continues inland in far background. No relocation to seaside castle.
135.narration: The transport continues inland while you keep him below the ridge.

136.visual_beat: Rusk tries to rise at SAME cliff edge; Varen braces to meet him. Local rock chips from earlier impact remain, no blood or dead-body implication.
136.narration: You stay until you can no longer see the transport. Rusk tries to rise again, and you meet him at the cliff edge.

137.visual_beat: Varen flies alone from SAME broad shelf toward harbour; Rusk stays seated on stone behind him, alive but stopped. No beige exposed skin under torn grey suit.
137.narration: When he finally stops moving toward the city, you leave him on the broad stone shelf and fly back alone.

138.visual_beat: Varen lands unsteadily beside SAME centre yard, one white hand touching concrete. Torn shoulder shows WHITE skin only; fixed workshop entrance empty, gate-wall crack retained.
138.narration: Your suit is torn at the shoulder. You land badly in the yard and cannot make your hands stop shaking.

139.visual_beat: Varen opens the nearer right olive locker and removes ONE folded note from under its latch. Workshop empty except him, same furnishings, no missing door.
139.narration:
The workshop door is open, but nobody is inside.

Mira has left a note beneath the locker latch.

140.visual_beat: Varen approaches yellow-edged open entrance of SAME inland repair shed. Mira's crew and residents visible inside, no harbour or bridge behind.
140.narration: It names the inland freight depot where her crew took the stranded residents. You find them in the repair shed behind it.

141.visual_beat: Talen sits against SAME left crate stack holding ONE arm close to body, blue sash intact. Varen kneels beside him, torn shoulder skin stays WHITE.
141.narration: Talen is sitting against a crate with one arm held close to his body. He tells you the transport will have to stay here.

142.visual_beat: Talen gestures toward one mission recorder/navigation record on centre table while Varen listens; no second ship suddenly inside cramped shed.
142.narration: Taking it back means explaining why he was flying civilians away from Rusk's inspection.

143.visual_beat: Varen sits beside existing yellow-edged roll-up doorway while Mira checks the dirt-road approach with crew. Blue side door stays RIGHT.
143.narration: Mira lets you sit beside the entrance while her crew checks the road.

144.visual_beat: Mira hands seated Varen ONE dry cloth to cover torn shoulder at same yellow doorway; white skin only/no gore; her yellow jacket and his red suit details fixed.
144.narration: She gives you a dry cloth for the cut beneath your sleeve. You tell her Rusk survived.

145.visual_beat: Mira indicates inland dirt route away from shed while Varen holds the cloth over white shoulder; anonymous residents gather plain supply bundles by left crate stack. Talen stays seated with hurt arm beside the same doorway; skin pure WHITE.
145.narration: She says that means they need to keep moving. Nobody treats the fight as a victory large enough to solve the invasion.

146.visual_beat: Mira, Varen and Talen examine ONE simple paper route map on SAME centre worktable; Varen points at an access line. Back pegboard/left crates/right shelves unchanged.
146.narration: They ask which routes the Empire knows, and you answer from the map you helped make.

147.visual_beat: Varen and Talen guide ONE grey imperial transport away from dirt depot loading yard before dawn, beyond SAME open front. No duplicate transports or boats.
147.narration: You and Talen move the transport beyond the depot before the next morning.

148.visual_beat: Varen carries ONE stacked plain supply bundle along left dirt path toward right boulder refuge; Mira checks a navigation record at fixed supply table.
148.narration: Mira takes its navigation record and keeps the vehicle routes separate from it. You carry supplies to a shelter Rusk never saw.

149.visual_beat: Mira raises a wait hand at SAME timber entrance while Varen pauses outside on dirt path; anonymous adult residents inside in plain clothes all WHITE skin.
149.narration: When you return, she asks you to wait outside while the residents decide whether they want you nearby.

150.visual_beat: Mira opens SAME refuge timber entrance and waves waiting Varen along the left path toward it. No replacement home or shifted boulder.
150.narration:
You stay by the path until she opens the door.

The days after that are ordinary in ways you never trained for.

151.visual_beat: Varen gently tightens ONE connection on same green pump; pipes remain attached to back/right wall. Talen watches fixed left doorway, BLUE sash unchanged.
151.narration: You help repair a pump without pulling its pipes from the wall. Talen watches the approach while you work.

152.visual_beat: Mira measures SAME central wood upright/base plate while Varen waits with hands lowered and anonymous crew move fully clear; three wood posts and olive tarp fixed.
152.narration: Mira measures a support before asking you to lift it, and you wait for her crew to move clear.

153.visual_beat: Varen holds the SAME sagging beam motionless with BOTH hands while Mira tightens its central support bolt. Same three wooden uprights and white skin; quiet useful ending. Talen watches approach at existing open side, BLUE sash unchanged.
153.narration: You still know how to seize the place. For now, you stand where she points and hold the beam until the bolts are tight.
